div.head: Af 1.7
div.ab: Gif he þonne losie, sy he aflymed ⁊ sy he amansemod of eallum Cristes cyricum.
Gif he losige, sie he áfliemed ⁊ sie ámænsumod óf eallum Cristes ciricum.
Si amittatur, sit forsbannitus et excommunicatus ab omnibus Christi ecclesiis.
Gif he losige, sie he afliemed ⁊ sie ámænsumod óf eallum Cristes ciricum.
If he escapes, let him be banished and excommunicated from all churches of Christ.
If he succeeds in making his escape, he shall be banished, and excommunicated from all the churches of Christ.
If he gets clear, he is to be outlawed, and to be excommunicated from all the churches of Christ.
Wenn er entkommt, werde er geächtet und werde excommunicirt aus allen Kirchen Christi.
If he gets away, let him be outlawed and excommunicated from all the churches of Christ.
